question: Which provinces entering a game makes again, and whether a battle's capture always does

addresses.name: RebuildProvinceModifierValues
addresses.comment: **A province's modifier, made again from nothing.** 0x49F3E0 to two `ret 4` in one frame, 0x4A0673 and 0x4A0689 (int3 from 0x4A068C), read whole on the listing 2026-10-14 (FINDINGS-occupation.md section A). The database is static_modifiers.txt's, g_static_modifiers ([0x1A86208]); the destination is the CProvinceModifier at +0xFC (values at +0x114), whose +8/+0xC vector is the list of contributors a tooltip reads. In order: (1) 0x4595C0 zeroes the values and empties the contributor vector; the province's list of scaled copies (+0x12C) is emptied (0x4B6260). (2) **Buildings** (+0x310..+0x314) whose level_max (+0x20) is above the fixed-point global at 0x1A870F4: effect (+0x10) = definition->effect_size (+8), then effect = level_current (+0x24) x effect / 1000 (64-bit, truncated), added at the id of the kind at +0x14 (its +0x24); `changed` (+0x28) cleared. **Not put on the contributor list.** (3) `overseas` and the `blockaded` nested in it (RebuildProvinceModifierValues_Overseas). (4) `non_core` (RebuildProvinceModifierValues_NonCore). (5) one of `coastal` / `non_coastal` / `coastal_sea` by the template (_CoastalFamily). (6) `no_adjacent_controlled` (_NoAdjacentControlled). (7) **the occupation policy** (_OccupationPolicy). (8) `blockaded` a second time where the port is blockaded (+0x36C, _BlockadedPort). (9) `land_province` or `sea_zone` (_LandOrSea). (10) `manpower` times the province's manpower (_Manpower). (11) `nationalism` times the province's nationalism (_Nationalism). (12) the province's dated modifiers, +0x13C, the expired ones removed (_EventModifiers). (13) the radar bookkeeping (_Radar). (14) `revolt_risk` times the effective revolt risk (read_static_modifier_revolt_risk; FINDINGS-occupation.md section B). Every static is added whole, id by id over ([0x1A86198]-[0x1A86194])/4 modifier kinds, and pushed onto the contributor vector; the three scaled ones (10, 11, 14) are fresh 0x48-byte CStaticModifier copies (source tag +0x40 = 0xF) scaled by CModifier_ScaleValues and kept on +0x12C until the next rebuild frees them. **Corrected 2026-10-14**: this entry said it ends at 0x4A0673 and folds in 'the province's own modifier list (+0x12C)'; the end is 0x4A068B, +0x12C is the list of scaled copies, and the dated modifiers are +0x13C. FINDINGS-revolt.md section 3's 'eight 0xB94936 / 0x4C0700 pairs - the timed and conditional province modifiers' are inlined vector push_back growth paths (0xB94936 throws length_error 'vector<T> too long', 0x4C0700 is the reserve) and not modifiers at all. **Its 15 callers** (findRefs.py --callers, 2026-10-14), so when a province's modifier is made again: RunMonthlyPass (0x683B9A, every province from index 1, before that month's nationalism decay); RunHourlyProvincePass (0x49EA97, where any of the province's buildings has its `changed` byte, +0x28, set - which a bombing, a fallen-back defender's damage and the day's repair set); RunDailyProvincePass (0x49EE0A, where the day's repair carried a building across a whole level); CMapProvince::TakeControl (0x4A215B, a battle's capture); CMapProvince::ChangeOwner (0x4A38E2); SetProvinceBuildingLevel (0x4A3B41); CProvince_AddTimedModifier (0x4A08F3); CChangeOccupationPolicyCommand::Execute (0x550FA7); CExecuteDecisionCommand::Execute (0xA09754); CCgmSetBuildingLevelCommand::Execute (0x42CC3F); ApplyCustomGameSettings (0x41E050); and CInGameIdler::Enter four times, in two loops over every province of the vector from index 0 (read on the listing 2026-10-15): the first (0x65AE30-0x65AFBD) on every entry, nothing before it able to skip it, rebuilding each province (0x65AFA8) and then calling 0x4963F0 and ComputeProvinceClimate and clearing the province's +0xC byte; the second (0x65BD12-0x65C01C) calls 0x4A7210 on each province and, where the game state's +0xD9C byte is clear - a new game, not a load - rebuilds it (0x65BF7A) before SpawnFullRevoltInProvince, and in every case rebuilds it once more at the end of its turn (0x65BFF1, or 0x65C00F where a REB-held province's history has an entry of type 0x1ED matching its +0x338). So entering a game makes every province again at least twice. CMapProvince::TakeControl's call (0x4A215B) is reached only where Province_SetController (0x4A20EF) changed the controller: 0x4A20F8 compares the province's +0x338 with the controller before and jumps past the rebuild at 0x4A20FE when they agree. **Province_SetController is not among them**: a plain change of controller - the day's return of occupied land, an effect - leaves the province's modifier as it was until one of these. The entry said 'and the screen' until 2026-10-14; no caller is a screen.
addresses.evidence: Listing of CInGameIdler::Enter from its start (0x65A2B0), so the instructions are aligned: the loop at 0x65AE30 counts esi from 0 to ([state+0xB90]-[state+0xB8C])/4 and no jump before it targets past 0x65AFC2; the loop at 0x65BD12 counts [esp+0x50] the same way, with `cmp byte [ecx+0xD9C],0; jne 0x65C00A` before 0x65BF7A. TakeControl 0x4A20EF-0x4A215B: `call 0x4A2400; mov eax,[esp+0x2C]; cmp [esi+0x338],eax; je 0x4A2160`.
addresses.revises: Says which provinces CInGameIdler::Enter's four calls make again - every one, in two loops, the second also before a new game's revolt pass - and that TakeControl rebuilds only where the controller changed.
